readings: Reset is synchronous and only applied on a rising Clk edge when EN=1; if EN=0, Rst is ignored and SP, stack_mem, and flags hold their values.
Reset is an active-high reset independent of EN (and may be asynchronous); asserting Rst clears SP to 4, clears stack_mem to 0, and updates flags regardless of EN or Clk edge.
dataOut is registered on the read clock edge, so the popped value appears one cycle after the read is sampled.
dataOut is combinational from the current top of stack (stack_mem[SP]) and reflects the popped entry in the same cycle as the pop.
EMPTY and FULL are combinational functions of SP and change in the same cycle as a push/pop updates SP.
EMPTY and FULL are registered flags updated on the clock edge, so they change one cycle after the push/pop.
When EMPTY=1, dataOut is forced to 0 (or to the reset value of stack_mem).
When EMPTY=1, dataOut holds its previous value or outputs an undefined/stale top-of-stack entry.
